title: 2743 E Co Hwy 30A, Unit 303 Vacation Rental
meta_description: 2743 E Co Hwy 30A, Unit 303 is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- Balcony Overlooking The Gulf and 30A- 4 Adult Bikes Included with Rental- Designated Parking Spot For 1 Vehicle with Covered Parking, 1 Additional Unassigned Space in Parking Lot Available- Private Beach Access With Gulf Front Pool - Ice Machine For Guest Use Located At The Pool- Iconic Surfing Deer Restaurant Located on First Floor of Building - 6 Minute Walk to Seaside DETAILS:Located in Seagrove Beach, just steps from the Gulf of Mexico and Seaside, luxury awaits at Viridian Unit 303. Featuring spectacular Gulf views, expansive outdoor living, and high-end features throughout, this 3,215 square foot, 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom condo provides impeccable accommodations for up to 8 guests. Thoughtfully designed and professionally decorated, the open floor plan has plenty of room for entertaining friends and family and enjoying the coastal atmosphere from inside or out. Accessible by elevator or stairway, this opulent contemporary- style condo features two beautiful king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms as well as a third bedroom hosting two queen beds with an ensuite bathroom. The exclusive Gulf front pool and beach access is a spectacular private amenity for guests to enjoy the sunshine from a lounger, take a dip in the pool, or walk down the private boardwalk to the beach. The gated pool area offers a spa, sun shelf in the pool with lounge seats, plenty of comfortable areas to relax and sunbathe, an outdoor shower, and bath houses. With some of the best dining, shopping, events, and beaches are right at your fingertips, including Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market Café on property as well as Seaside just a quick stroll away, this location can’t be beat for the perfect 30A getaway. With the amenities you want and the luxury you deserve, look no further than Unit 303 at Viridian. Let us help you start planning your dream vacation today by contacting Sanders Beach Rentals.
